failureMessage: KRALİ araştırma kalitesini iyileştir (developer.suggestion.research.b2127a91-7c6) native local agent iteration sınırına ulaştı.

diagnosis.summary: Iteration limit hit on an underspecified fallback research-quality gap: architecture already binds Tier/ID evidence, but never deterministically checks that findings/summaries are content-supported by cited excerpts—partial dirty work went down brand/score hardcoding instead.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Missing atomic finding↔source content-alignment gate: AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier.verify and LocalIntelligence validateApproach/proposal selection only require cited evidenceIDs to exist in Tier A/B sets; researchFindings and approach.summary text are never lexically checked against AgentDevelopmentResearchEvidenceRecord.excerpt, so unsupported claims can still pass the quality contract.
evidence: Approved expected benefit is explicitly “daha tutarlı, doğrulanabilir kaynak ve bulgu eşleştirmesi” (AgentDevelopmentSuggestionStore.seededFallbackSuggestions fingerprint fallback:research-quality).

AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier.verify rejects missing/non-qualifying evidenceIDs and facet/origin counts, but never compares proposal.researchFindings or approach.summary tokens to evidence excerpts.
AgentLocalIntelligence.validateApproach only checks non-empty summary plus evidenceID/repositoryEvidenceID subset membership; no excerpt-overlap support test before accepting a generated approach.
Proposal selection similarly gates only mutationStarted=false and evidenceID subsets; researchFindings content is accepted unverified.
existing self-test development-research-quality-self-test.swift covers tier/false-positive/host rejection and ID-grounded pass/fail, not finding-vs-excerpt mismatch.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Local agent burned the primitivePatch budget without a trustworthy candidate because the gap had no runtime error, no resolver trace, and no strategy candidates—then drifted into non-generic quality-score tweaks (brand authorityDomains / excerpt scoring bonuses) that do not implement verifiable source↔finding matching and conflict with the no-brand-hardcode rule.
evidence: Failure state local_agent_iteration_limit with empty runtime source hints and “Mevcut strategy adayları: Yok”.
Provenance is deterministic-fallback:fallback:research-quality plus user-retry; reason is a re-research request, not a concrete runtime failure class.

Worktree already shows AgentDevelopmentResearchSourceClassifier.calculateSourceConsistency with authorityDomains brand list (google/microsoft/apple/…) and kind/domain score bonuses—orthogonal to finding↔excerpt alignment and non-generic.
AgentWebSourceReader.bestEvidence also contains soft “Evidence quality bonus” / multi-concept score bumps without a deterministic finding-binding contract.
KRALI_DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md documents prior local_agent_iteration_limit failures where inspection budget was exhausted before a minimal mutation.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Secondary gap for user-facing research answers: LocalIntelligence.synthesize prompts separation of evidence vs inference but has no deterministic post-check that synthesized claims remain supported by WebSourceEvidence.excerpt / matchedConcepts; AgentVerifier research checks are count/domain oriented and AgentVerifier.swift is outside mutation ALLOW scope.
evidence: synthesize builds evidenceText from WebSourceEvidence excerpts then returns model text with no lexical support filter.
Benefit wording targets research answers broadly, not only development-research proposals.

AllowedScope includes AgentLocalIntelligence.swift and AgentWebSourceReader.swift but denies AgentVerifier.swift / AgentEngine.swift, so any user-answer grounding must live in synthesis/reader layers.

recommendedNextSteps: Discard/avoid brand authorityDomains and host soft-score expansions; they are not the approved atomic behavior.
Implement one generic support primitive: token-overlap (reuse existing normalizeTokens / relevanceTokens stopword style) between claim text and the union of cited evidence excerpts.
Wire that primitive into AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier.verify for each approach.summary and each proposal.researchFindings entry against cited evidenceIDs; fail .attention when unsupported.
Mirror the same check inside LocalIntelligence.validateApproach (and optionally proposal acceptance) so unsupported generations never reach the verifier as false greens.
Extend Scripts/development-research-quality-self-test.swift with one fixture: valid Tier A/B IDs + mismatched finding text => not .passed; aligned finding text => .passed.
Only if budget remains: optional lightweight post-filter in LocalIntelligence.synthesize for user answers using WebSourceEvidence excerpts—still generic, no brand/app hardcodes.
Keep mutation inside ALLOW paths; stop at ready_for_review after research-development-verifier / build-check PASS.
testsRequired: Scripts/research-development-verifier.command must still emit research_development_verifier_ok, development_research_quality_policy_ok, staged_research_synthesis_policy_ok
Scripts/development-research-quality-self-test.swift: add finding↔excerpt mismatch BLOCKED + aligned findings PASS
Scripts/build-check.command PASS on the candidate worktree
No new brand/app/site hard-coded branches in classifier/reader diffs
warnings: Gap evidence is a seeded fallback suggestion, not a Mentor runtime stack trace; do not invent PASS from narrative research text alone.
calculateSourceConsistency authorityDomains / medium.com-as-organizationEngineering style lists violate the brief’s no brand/site hard-code rule and should not be the candidate.
Do not widen into AgentEngine, AgentVerifier, Mentors, VERSION, or research-development-verifier.command.
Do not add new source files; keep Tier staging and mutation-off invariants intact.
This diagnosis is read-only; a mutation agent must produce the actual primitive patch.
